description: High-difficulty raid mechanics, HP triggers, and omen cancel conditions for Magna 3, Revans, and Apex raids.

raids.name: Colossus Ira Omega
raids.mechanicsSummary: High defense with heat dissipation phases. Omens demand high hit-counts and water multi-hit skills. Guarding reduces heat vents.

omensAndTriggers.name: Magma Core Overdrive (75%)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Deals massive fire plain damage and inflicts Burn (5000/turn)
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Clear with Payila 4-hit normal attacks or Haaselia skill spam.

omensAndTriggers.name: Dimensional Cleave: Ira (25%)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Instantly defeats targeted ally (ignores normal defense)
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Use Vajra double Ougi or Poseidon substitute.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Maintain 200% charge bar chains to clear damage and Ougi omens effortlessly on Full Auto.

raids.name: Tiamat Aura Omega
raids.mechanicsSummary: Spawns storm barriers that nullify non-critical damage. Relies on 100% crit grids and fire burst rotations to shred barriers.

omensAndTriggers.name: Aerial Jail (80%)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Imprisons frontline allies in Aerial Jail (unable to act for 2 turns)
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Ensure 100% critical grid active before pushing 80%.

omensAndTriggers.name: Supercell Burst (20%)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Teamwide 30,000 plain damage and buff wipe
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Save Percival Sk2 and Zeta nukes to cancel instantly.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Turn 1 Percival 3 Tri-Strike obliterates boss HP; cancels all initial omens with massive raw burst.

raids.name: Diaspora
raids.mechanicsSummary: Two distinct phases: Phase 1 (Activation sequence: α-hit count, β-skill damage, or γ-charge attack damage). Raid groups universally run '100% γ' to ensure smooth Phase 2 transitions. Phase 2 (Emergency Repair / Cell Death) triggers relentless 36-hit or 99-hit omens.

omensAndTriggers.name: Gamma Absorption Protocol
omensAndTriggers.cancelCondition: Deal 30,000,000 CA damage in a single turn
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Ramps α or β counter if non-CA damage is dealt
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Earth Kengo Ougi setup exclusively attacks with charge attacks until γ reaches 100.

omensAndTriggers.name: Annihilation Ray (30%)
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Hrunting plain nuke or Caim 3-turn skill copy cancels this instantly.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Charge attack every turn to charge γ to 100, then open raid backup for Robin Hood bursters to clear Phase 2 in seconds.

raids.name: Seofon
raids.mechanicsSummary: Inflicts Spirit Sword stacks with every uncanceled trigger. At 5 stacks, boss gains permanent elemental cut and multi-nukes the party. Demands continuous 40M damage or 6-charge-attack cancels.

omensAndTriggers.name: Infinite Creacion (Every 3 Turns)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Gains 1 Spirit Sword stack; deals 40,000 teamwide damage
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Must cancel or guard all 4 frontline units.

omensAndTriggers.name: Cuatro Mil Espadas (10%)
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Use Triple Zero Phase 2 or full burst chain.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Satyr auto-cleanse and auto-heal counteracts Seofon's chip damage while Kengo Ougi chains satisfy CA cancel thresholds.

raids.name: Siegfried
raids.mechanicsSummary: Applies Uyuni status: all non-water healing damages allies, and normal defense is sharply lowered. Requires Wind teams with high natural defense (Sette di Spade grids) and multi-hit skill nukes.

omensAndTriggers.name: Manigance (Every 3 Turns)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Boss gains 50% DEF and ATK up
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Charlotta and Catura skill resets easily clear skill count omens.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Layer Sette di Spade Defense awakenings with Charlotta's permanent TA and skill cuts to achieve 100% full auto safety.

raids.name: Mugen
raids.mechanicsSummary: Phase 1 requires pushing to 70% without allowing Rampage gauge to hit 100. Phase 2 (Rampage) continuously hits for lethal normal attacks that must be redirected to undying tanks (Haaselia/Anne/Paladin).

omensAndTriggers.name: Ballistic Rampage Transition (70%)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Resets all debuffs, transforms into Rampage Mugen
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Re-apply all debuffs immediately with Shalem/Gabriel.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Poseidon redirects multi-hit attacks while Haaselia double-casts barrier and ATK cuts, completely neutralizing Rampage.

raids.name: Cosmos
raids.mechanicsSummary: Balance Gauge mechanic: party actions shift the scale toward Order (CA damage) or Chaos (Normal Attack/Skill damage). If the gauge hits 100% in either direction, boss triggers an instant team wipe (Equilibrium Fall).

omensAndTriggers.name: Extreme Shift Imbalance Omen
omensAndTriggers.cancelCondition: Perform counter-action (Ougi if skewed toward Chaos, Normal Attack if skewed toward Order)
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Monitor gauge every single turn; alternate attack types strictly.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Fediel field and Lich auto-nukes supply Chaos points while MC Ougis supply Order points to lock the scale at 50% neutral.

raids.name: Agastia
raids.mechanicsSummary: Spawns 6 Satellite nodes. Dealing 6 Charge Attacks per turn disables satellites. Boss applies extreme skill seal and continuous plain damage ticks unless delayed.

omensAndTriggers.name: Satellite Cannon (Every 2 Turns)
omensAndTriggers.cancelCondition: Deal 6 Charge Attacks in a single turn
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Inflicts permanent Skill Seal to 2 allies
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Light Kengo with Horus double Ougi effortlessly cancels this trigger.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Horus and Cosmos double Ougi every turn, satisfying the 6 CA cancel condition with 100% consistency.

raids.name: Dark Rapture Zero (Faa-0)
raids.mechanicsSummary: The ultimate challenge in Granblue Fantasy. Features 12 Labors 2.0, extreme plain damage entry cuts, and Phase 3 (20%-0%) where the boss takes 6 actions per turn and must be executed in 4-5 turns flat.

omensAndTriggers.name: Paradise Lost (80%)
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Use Triple Zero Phase 2 or coordinate full team burst.

omensAndTriggers.name: Axion Apocalypse (Every Turn)
omensAndTriggers.penaltyIfUncanceled: Kills 1 party member permanently per turn
omensAndTriggers.mitigationNotes: Full burst with all cooldown resets and assassin turns.

teamTemplates.strategySummary: Yamato Sk1 doubles omen cancel progression while Yuni resets all skills on turn 10+ to survive the 20% execute phase.
